_comment: K-356 `weather-symbols` GLOBAL data (design docs/worksheet-gen/b4-designs/K-356-weather.md §5 `WEATHER_SYMBOLS`; every picture OPENED 2026-09-21 on a 160 px colour + 56 px greyscale contact sheet, scratch K-356-sheet.png). pale-to-navy cloud with ~30 dark drops; the drops are the darkest marks on the sheet (raindrop = one blue drop, reads water)
navy cloud with a red-and-yellow bolt; the strongest symbol in mono (stormy = a RED cloud with rain + bolt, the red misreads)
pale blue six-arm flake with a dark outline; the palest symbol, the outline keeps the star; the teal badge ring and white fill save it
five bands over two pink clouds; a graded arch in mono
